name: interocitor-monorepo
description: Interocitor runtime packages, Swift client, documentation, and runnable examples.

scripts.check:publint: publint run packages/core --strict --pack false && publint run packages/web --strict --pack false && publint run packages/react --strict --pack false && publint run packages/workers --strict --pack false
scripts.check:types: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/react/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/react/tsconfig.tests.json && tsc -p packages/workers/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.check:knip: knip --workspace packages/core --workspace packages/web --workspace packages/react --workspace packages/workers --include files --no-progress --reporter compact
scripts.check:static: yarn format:check && yarn lint && yarn check:types && yarn check:knip
scripts.validate: yarn check:static && yarn build:all && yarn test:unit && yarn test:contract:core-workers && yarn check:publint && yarn check:webdav-server && yarn check:docs:site && yarn check:docs:todomvc && yarn check:docs:chat && yarn check:docs:board && yarn check:docs:locator && yarn test:e2e:todo
scripts.preflight: yarn preflight:js && yarn preflight:python && yarn preflight:swift
scripts.preflight:js: yarn validate && yarn test:e2e:core && yarn test:e2e:web && yarn test:e2e:react && yarn test:e2e:docs:site && yarn test:e2e:docs:todomvc && yarn test:e2e:docs:chat && yarn test:e2e:docs:board && yarn test:e2e:docs:locator && yarn test:e2e:cloudflare:run
scripts.demo:todo: yarn build:int && yarn build:web && yarn demo:todo:server
scripts.test:unit: yarn workspace @interocitor/core test:unit && yarn workspace @interocitor/workers test
scripts.test:e2e:todo: yarn build:int && yarn build:web && yarn workspace todo-webdav-example check
scripts.test:e2e:cloudflare:run: yarn build:int && yarn build:web && RUN_CF_EXAMPLE_TESTS=1 playwright test -c examples/todo-cloudflare-do/playwright.config.ts
